# CANDIDATE: VIX1D_CONTANGO_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When near-term VIX1D is cheaper than 30-day VIX (contango), dealer gamma is low, allowing price to revert to VWAP on a pullback. This edge exists because contango indicates low near-term volatility expectations, reducing dealer gamma hedging pressure and enabling mean-reversion to VWAP after a pullback.

## Mechanism

Entry: Enter long when (1) VIX1D < VIX (contango condition), (2) price crosses above VWAP from below on a bullish candle (close > open), and (3) volume > 1.5× the 20-bar average volume. Exit: Initial stop at the recent swing low (structure invalidation), target at 1.5R, then trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR×3) after TP1 is hit. Regime filter: Only trade when VIX < 25 and during the morning session (09:30-11:30 EST).
